It sounds incredibly stressful to feel like you never know what mood your wife will be in when you get home. It is completely understandable that her recent escalation in mood swings and sudden impulsive behaviors, like dyeing her hair out of the blue, have you concerned for her well-being. 

Since these mood changes are becoming more frequent and severe, the most effective step is to encourage her to see a healthcare professional. A doctor or a psychiatrist can provide a proper evaluation to understand what is causing these shifts and recommend appropriate support, which might include therapy or medication to help stabilize her moods. Try having a gentle, non-judgmental conversation with her during a calm moment. You can express your love and concern for her health, and offer to help her find a professional or even accompany her to the appointment if she feels comfortable with that.
